players.product: Enhanced geothermal (EGS) 24/7 baseload power from modular GeoBlocks (Cape Station geocluster, Utah) under long-term PPAs with hyperscalers, utilities and industrial buyers, grid-connected and behind-the-meter

connects_to.relationship: enhanced geothermal power offtake (Geothermal Framework Agreement and power purchase agreements)

contracts.signal: Fervo's 8-K: on August 26, 2026 its subsidiary Cape Generating Station 6 LLC signed a PPA with Google Energy LLC, a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., for energy from a 396 MW EGS project at Cape Station in Beaver County, Utah, delivered in four successive 99 MW sub-tranches with target commercial operation dates beginning in the third quarter of 2028 and a 15-year delivery term; Google will purchase carbon-free energy designed to serve as a foundational building block for a potential data center in Utah. Fervo also agreed to offer Google a capacity expansion option of approximately 600 MW, for total contracted capacity of not less than approximately 950 MW with a guaranteed commercial operation date no later than June 2030 (subject to Google's acceptance and a definitive agreement); delivery may run through a closed private generation system under Utah SB 132, front- or behind-the-meter, with the expanded delivery capability targeted for the first half of 2030. The release calls it the world's largest enhanced geothermal PPA to date and recalls the 115 MW PPA with Google and NV Energy signed in June 2024.
contracts.units: 396 MW (four 99 MW sub-tranches); ~600 MW expansion option (not less than ~950 MW total)
